caption: fig01: top, DYN toy truth field of episode 67 (re-simulated, seed 8667, reversal/activation; white squares = L4 sensors, stars = sources, white contour = 30 % of peak population). Bottom, stored Belauri forward fields (results/belauri-forward, EXP-forward Phase 1; 500 m mesh; all emissions and winds synthetic). Not a result of an inference experiment.

fig02: DYN-04 layouts (results/dyn04/layouts.json, hash 8bdef74d7c30fe2e, frozen before any test episode; F-061, RUN-0090). Grey = synthetic population, stars = sources; markers are offset slightly so coincident layouts remain visible. Random layouts (10 per budget) omitted.

fig03: DYN-03 v2 (F-065, RUN-0094, frozen hash 3c86b5e668181a3d). ONE episode (median-gain 'activation' episode at L4/10 % noise, chosen by rule, not by appearance) re-simulated because per-episode histories were not stored; right panel checks the re-simulation against the stored J_pop. Synthetic, known wind, matched model. Illustration of mechanism, not evidence.

fig04: F-065 (corrects F-064) / RUN-0094 summary.json ('primary', 'wind_groups'); percentages in the left labels are relative changes. CT is the causal running static fit (a time-invariant model on the same causal data), not a current-time-only estimator (F-065); the D-014 negative control was retired by D-024 before RUN-0094, and the right panel shows only that steady winds also gain (it would fire). RETRO and M1 use future data (non-causal). Synthetic, known wind, one fixture. Preliminary, not independently reviewed.

fig05: F-061 / RUN-0090 summary.json 'contrasts' (40 contrasts; 96 test episodes seeds 7800-7895; CI = lenient Bonferroni 0.05/4 as registered, converted to % of the baseline mean). Blue = effect criterion met (CI excludes 0, >= 10 %, sign persists leave-one-wind-out); grey = tie or criterion not met; red = baseline better (point estimate >= +10 % with CI above 0; several of these become ties under the strict 0.05/40 family, see F-061). Grey band = +-10 %. Synthetic, known wind, hyper-parameters tuned on the spread layout (a comparator).

fig06: DYN-05 (F-062; design stage RUN-0078, design.json hash e3968dd3e90b6902; real-estimator check RUN-0080, 96 episodes seeds 8400-8495; tables docs/figures/dynamic/tables/fig06_design_summary.csv and dyn05_actual_regret_ci.json derived from those runs). Top: the registered surrogate criterion (met only in two of four cells). Bottom: descriptive, not the registered criterion; the CI conditions on the 16 ensemble layouts held fixed (a two-stage bootstrap in F-062 is wider). Reference layout is itself noisy (F-062 split-half). Synthetic, one fixture.

fig07: DYN-06 v4 (F-063, RUN-0093, protocol D-025: null-calibrated detection; misattribution scored only in (wind, cell) pairs where detection clearly exceeds false alarm; pooled = wrong/detected). Gaps in the lower row mean no wind was evaluable (d = 2 mostly). No CIs are stored for these rates (a registered requirement not met). The scoring rule was adopted after F-044's headline was contradicted; under the earlier unweighted mean S1/L4 at d=16 is 0.31 (F-063). S5 has no observable look-alike (detectability only). Synthetic, known wind.

fig08: DYN-07 v2 (F-056, RUN-0088; the same 96 episodes in 10 paired conditions; nominal inverse, frozen DYN-02 v3 hyper-parameters, never re-tuned). The 'extra source' conditions are confounded with the 9-sensor centre sensor (354 m from the unmodelled source; F-056) and are shown, not interpreted. Global wind rotations/scalings only; synthetic.

fig09: EXP-027 (F-057, RUN-0081; results/exp027/paired.csv; 8 draws x 6 cases, seeds 1101-1108; 28 replicate pairs). VOID: the deliberately coarse 2 km control is not distinguishable from replicate-design noise (it was required to fail), so the 500 m mesh is only provisionally admissible. Boxes = quartiles of per-draw values (8, 8, 28); dots are the values. Padded Belauri domain, synthetic population/winds.

fig10: DYN-02 v3 (F-055, RUN-0087 episodes.csv, 4 sensors, 16 episodes per wind). rotation_a supplies 68 % (2 % noise) / 48 % (10 %) of the pooled effect; a t-interval over the six wind means includes zero (F-055). Synthetic, known wind, matched model.

fig00 DYN-00 verification (EXP-028; .research/runs/RUN-0091/dyn00_checks.json; 25/25 checks pass) · RUN-0091 · n = 25 checks · synthetic toy geometry · mass-closure residuals (log) and temporal-order checks

fig17: EXP-026 (F-070, RUN-0098). Test population-weighted RMSE of the population layout minus the area layout, as a percentage of the area-layout RMSE (positive = population layout worse), by budget (2, 3, 4, 5, 8) for noise 0.05 (left) and 0.15 (right). Blue dots: concentrated synthetic fixtures (mean of 6 draws); orange diamonds: WorldPop with 95 % case-bootstrap intervals (12 cases). Low power: benefits of 20 % or more are not excluded in 15 of 35 cells.

fig18: EXP-026 (F-070, RUN-0098). Population-weighted versus area-weighted RMSE change for each non-identical comparison (35 synthetic concentrated cells in blue, 9 WorldPop cells in orange). The two RMSEs mostly move together along the diagonal; true trade-offs are in the minority.

fig19: EXP-026 (F-072, RUN-0098). Left: greedy design objective lies 28-79 % above the best found. Right: design-split optimism (other-half minus own-half objective, 3-case halves, budgets 5 and 8) of median 175-531 %. Illustrates that the design objective from 6 cases, rather than the test evaluation, is the primary source of instability (Q-013).

EXP-027b (F-075; post-hoc sensitivity F-077): E with 95 % intervals for the 500 m main mesh vs the 2 km control in the 4 (budget, noise) cells, stage 1 (hollow) vs stage 2 (filled), margin 0.05; J-ratio and rho panels. Stage 2 verdict main INADEQUATE with all 4 control cells failing the gate; stage 1 was main INCONCLUSIVE. Per-cell labels recomputed from the stored intervals. Synthetic scenarios.

DYN-08 v2 (RUN-0101, F-076): dyn_opt minus random (two-level layout x episode bootstrap) and minus spread/highpop/static_opt/src_opt (single layouts, labelled 'this layout only') in the 4 (k, noise) cells, with relative change. Synthetic emissions/episodes; real geometry; model-free of empirical validation.

DYN-08 v2 gating controls: a' (spread vs worst-surrogate-risk layout, effect expected) and b' (random group A vs B, no effect expected) in the 4 cells, relative M2 change with 95 % CI, plus the v1 lowpop-vs-spread layout (reported, not gating). All gates passed.
DYN-08 v2 model error: M2 error ratio vs matched under truth rotation 0/5/10/20 deg, speed x1.2 and 250 m mesh for dyn_opt and spread (95 % CI), and the M2/M1 ratio crossing 1. Synthetic episodes.

DYN-08 v1 vs v2 control outcomes per cell (relative M2 change with 95 % CI and the stored pass/fail). The v1 controls failed (F-069: lowpop did not lose to spread in 3 of 4 cells; the stored 'must be > 0' flag passes on sign alone at +2 % [-12, +16]; random replicate groups differed at k=5), which is why D-029 registered v2 with new controls (F-076). Shown unedited.

DYN-08 v2 layouts (dyn_opt, spread, highpop, worst, first random replicate) at k=5, noise 2 %, on the Belauri study polygon with WorldPop 500 m population shading; sites mapped from candidate indices through layouts.json 'candidates' ids to the geodesign candidate table UTM coordinates. Modelled population estimate, synthetic design study.
